title: Verify: History error and Retry unit tests
summary: Unit tests for error alert and Retry
description: Test error rendering and that Retry re-calls listMine and recovers.
acceptance_criteria: Alert and Retry asserted on rejection
Retry calls listMine twice and shows list

steps.action: Create jsdom test file mocking listMine. Test 1: mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('boom')); await findByText('Could not load your suggestions') and assert button named Retry exists. Test 2: first call rejects, second resolves [contributionFixture] from tests/fixtures/api.ts (mirrors backend contributionJSON); click Retry; await findByText(contributionFixture.prompt); assert listMine toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2) and the error text is gone.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionHistoryError.test.tsx
